name: How long does it take to complete a garage entry accessibility upgrade?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a garage entry accessibility upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a garage entry accessibility upgrade depends on the complexity of the project. Minor installations, like grab bars or a new automatic door opener, might take a few hours to a day. More significant modifications, such as widening an entry point or building a custom ramp, could take several days to a week or more. We provide an estimated timeline during the initial consultation, factoring in material availability and specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines vary: minor upgrades take hours to a day, while major renovations like ramps or widened doorways can take several days to over a week.
